content:
The SERVFAIL responses were caused by a problem on one of the authoritative DNS servers, not by the queried name itself. The incident write‑up (INC‑0076) explains that the zone failed to load on **internal‑dns‑01**, so lookups that were routed to that server returned SERVFAIL, while queries that hit the healthy server succeeded. Thus the intermittent failures on notification‑worker‑01 were due to a server‑side issue.
